## A Heading Slide

Body text goes here. `.reveal p` line-height and `.reveal strong`
color are already styled — just write normally.

**Key point** worth emphasizing appears in FC blue automatically.

### A Sub-point

Use `###` for a smaller, italicized sub-heading within a slide,
styled in `--fc-sky`.

## Callout Boxes

::: {.blue-box}
Use `.blue-box` for a primary emphasis callout — solid FC blue
background, white text.
:::

::: {.yellow-box}
Use `.yellow-box` for a highlight or warning-style callout.
:::

::: {.gray-box}
Use `.gray-box` for a lower-emphasis supporting note — light
background, blue left border.
:::
